prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless horizontal web UI material texture for a private social Teen Patti table rail
Input images: Image 1 is the approved UI comp, used only to match the rail's warm dark mahogany and restrained lacquer finish; do not reproduce any table geometry, object, or UI from it.
Primary request: Generate a single edge-to-edge, seamless and horizontally tileable 1024 × 256 material swatch of dark mahogany wood under a restrained lacquer finish. The image must be flat material texture only; the rail shape, bevels, borders, lighting, and interface will be built in semantic CSS.
Scene/backdrop: orthographic macro material study, evenly filling the entire 4:1 canvas, with no horizon.
Style/medium: realistic premium dark mahogany veneer with subtle continuous horizontal grain beneath a low-gloss hand-rubbed lacquer, tactile and production-ready rather than decorative.
Composition/framing: perfectly flat front-on material strip, uniform edge-to-edge coverage, grain traveling continuously left to right, seamless at the left and right edges and visually safe for cover or repeat; no central vignette or edge shading.
Lighting/mood: diffuse even low-key illumination with only restrained satin micro-sheen, quiet adult private-clubhouse atmosphere.
Color palette: stay strictly within #261711 to #41281F, with a net dark warm-brown field near #321E18; no orange, red, gold, or black hotspots.
Materials/textures: fine-to-medium horizontal mahogany grain, restrained tonal ribbons, occasional subtle pore detail, no strong knots or singular marks that reveal repetition.
Constraints: opaque; no transparency; no text, logos, symbols, ornaments, objects, seams, table shapes, bevels, borders, brass, cards, chips, seats, people, icons, controls, buttons, room codes, spotlights, vignettes, gradients, watermarks; must tile cleanly left to right.
Avoid: glossy mirror reflections, dramatic specular streaks, carved details, planks, joins, panels, scratches, stains, knots, perspective, photographic depth of field, directional shadows.
